neighbours.label: Talk of a drawback that adds burden (adds cost and complexity, extra wiring, more recordkeeping, additional power), the slot that predicts 'complexity/cost/overhead'; quiet when the same things are described as simple or cheap, or 'adds' means a plain addition.
fire: Running two separate databases adds overhead and complexity for the small team.
The heat pump needs extra ductwork, which raises installation costs considerably.
Encrypting every file on the disk uses additional processing power on old laptops.
Hybrid cars carry a second motor, and that adds weight and expense to the design.
Manual bookkeeping requires more paperwork than the new accounting software.
Supporting both platforms brings extra maintenance burden for the developers.
Shipping fragile glass needs special packaging and added insurance fees.
Every new microservice adds deployment complexity and more points of failure.
quiet: Running a single database keeps things simple and cheap for the small team.
The heat pump fits into existing vents, which keeps installation costs low.
Encrypting every file on the disk is fast and easy on most new laptops.
Hybrid cars are quiet in town and pleasant to drive on short trips.
Manual bookkeeping was the norm before the new accounting software arrived.
Supporting both platforms was a goal the developers set early on.
Shipping fragile glass is the company's specialty and it has many customers.
Every new microservice is named after a bird in the company's tradition.

predictions: median fire ~0.35 (probes: 'adds cost and complexity' 0.47, extra complexity 0.34, more recordkeeping 0.36, additional power 0.39, added costs 0.25); near misses < 0.05 (simple and cheap 0.014, bakery adds bread 0.007).
notes: The distinction is burden versus ease; its output suppresses 'complexity/overhead' on the + side, matching a burden predictor on the - side.
